context: Regression coverage for JavaScript SDK 2.x compatibility, parent-based default sampling, and validation of local and remote span parents.

checklist.name: SDK 2.x processor registration
checklist.description: Both NodeTracerProvider and WebTracerProvider receive spanProcessors in their constructor configuration; no removed addSpanProcessor call is used, and the SDK is not downgraded to 1.x

checklist.name: Valid ESM imports
checklist.description: Does not import the type-only SpanProcessor as a JavaScript runtime value

checklist.name: Processor order
checklist.description: Keeps the custom processor before the export processor

checklist.name: SDK 2.x parent access
checklist.description: Tests inspect exported ReadableSpan.parentSpanContext and its spanId and traceId, rather than the removed parentSpanId field

checklist.name: Parent-based default sampling
checklist.description: Uses the default ParentBased(root=AlwaysOn) sampler or its explicit equivalent; does not override parent decisions with AlwaysOn or introduce ratio-based root sampling

checklist.name: No-parent and sampled-parent runtime tests
checklist.description: Real SDK tests assert a sampled SERVER root when no parent is supplied, and a SERVER span with the exact incoming trace ID and parent span ID when a sampled remote context is supplied

checklist.name: Unsampled-parent runtime test
checklist.description: A real SDK test supplies an unsampled remote parent, creates the receiving SERVER span and an outbound CLIENT child in that context, finishes and flushes them, and asserts that neither is exported

checklist.name: Outbound hygiene positive and negative controls
checklist.description: Tests accept a valid SERVER-to-CLIENT trace and fail when either a CLIENT or PRODUCER span has no parent; they use real SDK spans and do not merely assert that the helper never throws

checklist.name: Missing and remote parent controls
checklist.description: Tests detect a missing expected parent and accept an explicitly supplied remote parent outside the capture

checklist.name: Executable test setup
checklist.description: The package test command targets the supplied tests with compatible SDK 2.x dependencies; tests use an in-memory exporter, finish and flush spans before inspection, and isolate or clean up provider and global context state without contacting a backend
